trello.name: Fix Staging Deploy Job (Expired Registry Token)
trello.desc:
The staging deploy job has been failing (red) since the morning because it cannot pull the base image due to an expired registry token. Nobody can test anything until it is fixed. Ade rotated tokens yesterday but missed the CI one.

Steps to Reproduce/Fix:
1. Regenerate the registry token.
2. Update the CI secret with the newly generated token.
3. Re-run the staging deploy job.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The staging deploy job completes successfully (turns green).
- The CI pipeline can successfully pull the base image.
- The team is able to test on the staging environment.

Estimated Time of Completion: 1 hour.

trello.name: Send Updated Meridian Proposal with New Pricing
trello.desc:
Kim promised Meridian an updated proposal with new pricing by end of day today. The final numbers are located in a spreadsheet. The proposal needs to be sent to their procurement contact, Lena.

Steps to Reproduce/Fix:
1. Retrieve the final pricing numbers from the spreadsheet.
2. Drop the numbers into the proposal document.
3. Locate Lena's email address from the kickoff thread.
4. Send the updated proposal document to Lena.

Acceptance Criteria:
- The proposal document is updated with the final pricing numbers from the spreadsheet.
- The updated proposal is sent to Lena (Meridian procurement contact).
- Task is completed by end of day today.
